Sora AI Video Generator Shut Down: Export and Alternatives

OpenAI discontinued Sora on the web and in the app on April 26, 2026, and ended the Sora API on September 24, 2026. If you have older work, check the official Sora export page using the account that created it. For a new video, pick a service that supports your starting input and use the same shot brief when comparing results.

  1. Choose what you need to do
  2. Export and verify older work
  3. Replace a Sora API workflow
  4. Choose an alternative for a new clip
  5. Build a reusable trial brief
  6. Sources and test scope

What do you need after Sora?

See stepsSee stepsSee steps

Export existing Sora work and check the download

  1. Use the official export page and sign in with the account where you made the videos. If the account shows Export, select it and wait for the email from OpenAI.
  2. Save the downloaded export in a folder you can find again. If it arrives as an archive, keep the original and extract a separate copy.
  3. Open the clips that matter to you in a local player. Verify that they play through, then compare the duration, picture and audio with what you expected. Save any prompts or reference material you still need separately.

If Export is absent, check the account before retrying. OpenAI says it will notify users by email if it offers a final export window, and describes eventual permanent deletion. Its notice gives no guaranteed future export date. Keep any working local copy while you check.

Replace a workflow that used the Sora API

Update jobs that still target the retired Sora models. Before choosing a replacement, record how your original job supplied prompts or images, waited for completion and downloaded the file.

  1. Check the new API for the exact input type, duration, aspect ratio and audio support you need.
  2. Update the adapter for its request fields, job status, failure handling and download mechanism. Save completed files before any provider-specific download deadline.
  3. Run one synthetic prompt in a test project. Confirm request acceptance, completion and local playback before pointing production jobs at the new API.

Check rates and credentials in the replacement provider’s own API docs. Web plan credits and API billing can have different rules.

Choose a Sora alternative for the clip you need

  • Starting with a still image: use the image-to-video guide for a documented guest trial and download checks. The provider’s current limits and terms can change.
  • Trying one short Runway clip: check model access and use the Runway trial budget to plan retries. Runway’s Gen-4.5 text route requires Standard or higher.
  • Comparing text-to-video or paid plans: check the video model and plan comparison for supported routes and the cost of one attempt.

If you are unsure, first choose between a prompt-only scene and animation of a particular image. Pick one small shot you can repeat and assess the saved output before scaling up.

Make a reusable video trial brief

Keep the scene, motion and framing fixed. Record unsupported settings and score the downloaded file against the same checks. Use the downloadable example or build your own below.

Target duration is a planning input. Check each provider’s available setting, record it, and compare the actual length after download. The builder works in this tab without file uploads.

Sources and test scope

OpenAI’s Sora discontinuation notice and API deprecations explain the shutdown and export route. We checked the sources on November 28, 2026 and tested the brief builder locally. An unauthenticated HTTP check of the export URL returned a browser challenge. We did not sign in or verify an account export.
